caption: The drawing depicts the upper part of a person's head and shoulders, focusing on a bonnet and its details. The bonnet is depicted in a pale gray or off-white, using pencil and possibly light watercolor for shading, and consists of multiple layers and ruffles. It has a puffed and rounded crown decorated with a row of large, soft, rounded elements along the top edge, which appear to be bows or rosettes. A smooth, wide band wraps around the forehead and meets a broad ribbon tied in a bow under the chin. The bonnet has ruffled trim framing the face, and close, wavy lines suggest the texture of curled hair visible on either side of the face. The face itself lacks detailed features, with only the outline of an oval head and a faint eyebrow and mouth suggested. At the neckline is a finely detailed, zigzag-edged collar. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, less detailed sketch depicting the back view of the same bonnet, showing its voluminous structure and how the decorative band continues around the back. The composition is rendered in delicate lines on an off-white background.
title: Headdress
